calls.title: BioTechUSA and GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting detailed the team's current utilization of Growth Book for an A/B test comparing search engines Algolia and Constructor, measuring their purchase impact. Béla Kállai leads this project, coordinating with marketing and development to optimize the experimentation process. With plans to expand testing to new website designs and product page layouts, the team anticipates running up to 10 experiments monthly once marketing fully adopts the platform. Growth Book's user-friendly features, like the Visual Editor, allow marketing teams to experiment independently, enhancing collaboration. As the team transitions from the free to the Pro tier of Growth Book, which caps experiments at five per month, they also discussed pricing considerations and the importance of marketing buy-in for broader adoption.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, A/B testing, feature toggle, Shopify search engine, Visual Editor, experiment automation
